upstream.description: Unlimited FREE AI coding. Connect Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Cline, Copilot, Antigravity to FREE Claude/GPT/Gemini via 40+ providers. Auto-fallback, RTK -40% tokens, never hit limits.

classification.analysis: 9Router is a local proxy/router that sits between AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Cline, Copilot, Antigravity) and 40+ upstream LLM providers, exposing an OpenAI-compatible API on localhost. It auto-falls back across subscription, cheap, and free tiers, tracks quota usage, and compresses tool-result payloads (RTK) to cut token consumption 20-40%. It ships as both an npm CLI/tray app and a Next.js dashboard, with Docker support for self-hosting. Aimed at developers who want to avoid hitting rate limits or paying for multiple LLM subscriptions while using AI coding assistants.

use_cases.title: Route Claude Code requests through free or cheap LLM providers to avoid subscription limits
Reduce token spend on agentic coding tools via automatic tool-output compression
Self-host a unified OpenAI-compatible endpoint for multiple AI coding CLIs
Auto-fallback between subscription, cheap, and free model tiers to prevent downtime
